status: Frozen separate proposal; the previous stopped attempt cannot resume. Another explicit one-shot authorization is required even though no allowance increase is proposed.
purpose: Compare actual combined review v6 with exact-citation v7. Both use identical semantic prompts, schemas, source-first v9 planning and unchanged look generation. Memory-only text preparations; no images or production writer.

sampling.method: Retain the exact seven hard and 23 previously drawn fresh fixtures; no cold preparation executed in the stopped attempt. No new draw, filtering, replacement or production query. The 23 remain outside the earlier 123. Reuse pair/order/masking seeds for traceability. Record source/canon bytes by hash and preserve all first outcomes in this distinct one-shot run.

method: Both arms use the same semantic prompts, schemas, model/provider/defaults and v9 planning, but actual v6/v7 citation acceptance. Each complete preparation starts from an identical source/canon snapshot and separate cold memory store; look randomness is independent. Fixed alternating arm order and one draw per arm/case. No tuning, substitutions or paid restart. Unavailable review after its two bounded attempts ends that operation as unavailable/refused; subsequent fixed operations continue only while provider usage is known and the global cap/guards permit. The preparation never stores an unchecked plan.

scoring.packet: After execution, seed-shuffle stored complete packets into opaque labels, omit arm/review/outcome/version/grounding. Include exact source, section bounds/title, same-section neighbors, full available assigned canon, selected IDs, five-field look and seven fields. Commit complete scores before unblinding. Single operator and familiar retained cases limit masking; no independent-adjudication claim.
scoring.criteria: Source-supported instant and cast identities; every depicted available character/group/location/object/no-form presence selected; no framing or separate-event cast, invented recurring identities, embodied no-form subject, pose/prop contradiction, collage, fixed-canon or art-style leakage. Generic roles, crowds, props and scenery are allowed when source-compatible. An uncertain stored scene counts against acceptance. Quote each defect and source/canon rationale; preserve sensitivity to every disputed score.
scoring.analysis: Report stored acceptable, flawed, uncertain and refused per arm, separately for 23 fresh and seven retained cases. Include paired 2x2 acceptable tables, exact two-sided McNemar/binomial discordance p-values, 95% Wilson intervals for each acceptable rate and discordant counts; this small diagnostic cannot establish population reliability. No refusal counts as repair. Report missing pairs as incomplete, without dropping them.
scoring.gate: All 92 operations complete without global stop, blocked ledger or uncertain usage. All 16 candidate controls pass, zero clean false alarms. Candidate has zero flawed/uncertain stores or look contradictions, at least 22/23 acceptable fresh and 7/7 retained, no fewer acceptable overall or retained than baseline, and no more total refusals. Ties are permitted: identical semantic prompts make strict superiority inappropriate for this technical citation change. This comparative condition replaces the previous strict-more condition before this run, not after pipeline outcomes; absolute gates are unchanged. Any unavailable candidate review fails its control or counts as pipeline refusal. A pass supports further validation only; activation remains held.

executionRequirements: Owner must explicitly authorize this distinct one-shot operation first; no allowance increase is proposed and prior funding files do not apply. Commit grant/code/protocol/fixtures/pricing/dry-run hashes before calls; refresh prices/balance and refuse drift. Reserve each HTTP request, retain per-call usage and enforce one-shot markers/call cap. Provider error, missing/uncertain usage, request/source drift, cap/headroom or interruption is a global stop. Semantic refusals and bounded unavailable reviews remain failed operations and do not stop unrelated cases. No automatic resume/restart or transfers from preparation/smoke.

controls.gate: All 16 candidate controls must pass; negatives need required kind/ID and a citation supported by their intended field, including exact v7 JSON citation forms. Positive controls require zero problems. Extra negative reports require source-based disposition. Baseline controls are descriptive. An unavailable review is a failed operation, never a pass, and does not by itself abort other fixed cases.

knownLimitation: Shared-look generation is unchanged and can dominate refusals. v7 is only an offline citation fix; no semantic/pipeline improvement is measured. Independent draws and one familiar operator prevent isolated causal or independent-adjudication claims. The preceding attempt stays 3/92 incomplete, never merged into these results.
